text:
I have fixed the three bugs identified by the test suite:

1.  **`toolkit/dates.py`**: Corrected `is_leap_year` to properly handle century rules (years divisible by 100 are not leap years unless they are also divisible by 400).
2.  **`toolkit/stats.py`**: Updated `median` to correctly compute the average of the two middle elements when the input list has an even number of values.
3.  **`toolkit/text.py`**: Replaced `s.title()` in `title_case` with a custom implementation that avoids capitalizing letters following apostrophes, as required by the tests.

All 15 tests now pass.
